# Warmline

> Claude Code plugin. A band above the chat prompt showing prompt-cache state (warm, cooling soon, cold), time left before cold, and the USD cost of a cache rebuild versus a refresh. Numbers come from the session transcript's usage data. Alerts before cold with one suggestion. English or Arabic (RTL).

Install (Claude Code): /plugin install warmline --marketplace MOHJRNL/warmline
Not supported: Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Grok.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): features, install, configuration, FAQ
- [Pricing and thresholds](hooks/config.ts): edit per-model USD prices and alert thresholds
